# Scopes inside procedures
# https://cloud.google.com/bigquery/docs/reference/standard-sql/data-definition-language#create_procedure
#
# Each script creates the dataset unverified_procedures and procedures of its own. The dataset
# stays in the project after the scripts run. The emulator rejects temporary functions and
# system variable assignments in procedures until these settle where they belong.

# Whether a temporary function declared in a procedure runs there, and after the procedure
# returns.

CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS unverified_procedures;
CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE unverified_procedures.call_function() OPTIONS(strict_mode=FALSE)
BEGIN CREATE TEMP FUNCTION declared_in_procedure() AS (1); SELECT declared_in_procedure(); END;
CALL unverified_procedures.call_function()
?>

CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS unverified_procedures;
CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE unverified_procedures.declare_function() OPTIONS(strict_mode=FALSE)
BEGIN CREATE TEMP FUNCTION declared_in_procedure() AS (1); END;
CALL unverified_procedures.declare_function();
SELECT declared_in_procedure()
?>

# Whether a procedure can set @@dataset_id, and whether its caller sees the value.

CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS unverified_procedures;
CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE unverified_procedures.read_set_dataset() OPTIONS(strict_mode=FALSE)
BEGIN SET @@dataset_id = 'unverified_procedures'; SELECT @@dataset_id; END;
CALL unverified_procedures.read_set_dataset()
?>

CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS unverified_procedures;
CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE unverified_procedures.set_dataset() OPTIONS(strict_mode=FALSE)
BEGIN SET @@dataset_id = 'unverified_procedures'; END;
CALL unverified_procedures.set_dataset();
SELECT @@dataset_id
?>

# What the caller's variable holds when the procedure never assigns its OUT argument, and when
# the procedure fails after assigning it.

DECLARE v INT64 DEFAULT 5;
CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS unverified_procedures;
CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE unverified_procedures.out_unassigned(OUT x INT64)
OPTIONS(strict_mode=FALSE) BEGIN SELECT 1; END;
CALL unverified_procedures.out_unassigned(v);
SELECT v
?>

DECLARE v INT64 DEFAULT 5;
CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS unverified_procedures;
CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE unverified_procedures.out_failed(OUT x INT64)
OPTIONS(strict_mode=FALSE) BEGIN SET x = 1; SELECT ERROR('fail'); END;
BEGIN CALL unverified_procedures.out_failed(v); EXCEPTION WHEN ERROR THEN SELECT 0; END;
SELECT v
?>
